name: ExportWarning

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The UUIDs of the server assets for which you want to export the baseline check results. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要导出基线检查结果列表的服务器资产的UUID。多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the baseline type to which the baseline check results to be exported belong.
The value is the TypeName field returned by the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation. If both TypeName and TypeNames are specified, only TypeName takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
设置要导出的基线检查结果所属的基线类型。
调用[DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~)接口返回的TypeName字段。TypeName、TypeNames这两个参数同时设置时，仅TypeName生效
parameters.name: type_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the baseline types to which the baseline check results to be exported belong. Separate multiple types with commas (,).

The value is the TypeName field returned by the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation. If both TypeName and TypeNames are specified, only TypeName takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
设置要导出的基线检查结果所属的基线类型。多个类型之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

调用[DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~)接口返回的TypeName字段。TypeName、TypeNames这两个参数同时设置时，仅TypeName生效
parameters.name: type_names

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the baseline subtypes to which the baseline check results to be exported belong. Separate multiple subtypes with commas (,).

The value is the TypeName field under the SubTypes field returned by the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation
parameters.help_zh:
设置要导出的基线检查结果所属的基线子类型。多个子类型之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

调用[DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~)接口返回的SubTypes字段下的TypeName字段
parameters.name: sub_type_names

parameters.help_en:
The risk levels of the baselines. Separate multiple risk levels with commas (,). Valid values:

high: High
medium: Medium
low: Low
parameters.help_zh:
基线的风险等级。多个风险等级之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

high：高危
medium：中危
low：低危
parameters.name: risk_levels

parameters.help_en:
The statuses of the risk items in the baseline check results. Separate multiple status values with commas (,). Valid values:

3: Passed
1: Failed
parameters.help_zh:
基线检查结果的风险项的状态。多个状态值之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

3：已通过
1：未通过
parameters.name: status_list

parameters.example: Alibaba Cloud Standard - Windows 2016/2019  Security Baseline
parameters.name: risk_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the baseline issue is handled. Valid values:

Y: The issue is handled.
N: The issue is not handled
parameters.help_zh:
基线问题是否已处理。取值：

Y：已处理
N：未处理
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to export the baseline check results in summary mode. Valid values:

0: The results are not exported in summary mode.
1: The results are exported in summary mode
parameters.help_zh:
基线检查结果是否汇总导出。取值：

0：否
1：是
parameters.name: is_summary_export

parameters.help_en: The ID of the baseline check policy
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the risk items in the baseline check results. Separate multiple risk item IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 基线检查结果的风险项ID。多个风险项ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: risk_ids

parameters.help_en: The type of the export task. Set the value to hc_check_warning, which indicates exporting baseline check results
parameters.help_zh: 导出任务的类型。固定取值为hc_check_warning，表示导出基线检查结果
parameters.name: export_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the export method for weak password baseline check results. Valid values:

0: Weak passwords are masked before export.
1: Weak passwords are exported in plaintext
parameters.help_zh:
弱口令基线检查结果的导出方式。取值：

0：弱口令进行脱敏后导出
1：弱口令直接明文导出
parameters.name: is_cleartext_pwd

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the server group.
You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to obtain the ID of the server group
parameters.help_zh:
服务器的分组ID。
您可调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取服务器的分组ID
parameters.name: group_id

FileName.description_en: The name of the exported baseline check result file
FileName.description_zh: 导出的基线检查结果文件的名称

Id.description_en:
The ID of the task that exports the list of baseline check results.

You can use this parameter to call the [DescribeHcExportInfo](~~DescribeHcExportInfo~~) operation to query the export progress
Id.description_zh:
导出基线检查结果列表的任务ID。

您可以使用该参数调用[DescribeHcExportInfo](~~DescribeHcExportInfo~~)查询导出进度

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
